{{Quest infobox | name = Destructive Research | map = | campaign = Eye of the North | region = Far Shiverpeaks | type = Secondary | given by = [[High Priest Alkar]] | given at = [[Battledepths]]
or [[Central Transfer Chamber]] | preceded by = [[Northern Allies]] | followed by = [[The Destroyer Challenge]] }} Bring [[High Priest Alkar]] some [[Destroyer]] samples to study so that he may learn how to defeat them. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Gather 3 [[Destroyer Core]]s. You have [3...0] of 3 left to collect. * See High Priest Alkar for your reward. ===Reward=== * 150 [[Dwarf reputation points]] * {{skill icon|Breath of the Great Dwarf}} * {{skill icon|Light of Deldrimor}} ==Walkthrough== Destroyer Cores are dropped by Destroyers, which can be encountered in large numbers in the [[Raven's Point]] dungeon, and during the [[A Gate Too Far]] or [[Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation|G.O.L.E.M.]] missions. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''High Priest Alkar''' :''"I know more of the [[Tome of Rubicon]] than any of my predecessors, and have written a sanitized version of that ancient text. [[King Jalis]] requested that I perform my Destroyer research practically at his side so I may relay my findings without delay. I could use your assistance to speed up the process. Bring me any '''Destroyer cores''' you find out there and I'll compensate you."'' {{offer dialog |accept = I'll find your junk. |decline = I'm not interested. |ask = I need '''Destroyer cores'''. Bring me 3 of them. Shake a leg! |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''High Priest Alkar''' :''"Excellent! You'll have to excuse me. I must get to work on these right away. Here, take this."''
